title: Chihuahua
content: I painted this chihuahua for my granddaughter. I used liquid acrylic on craft foam.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)I grew up with lots of dogs around. Bambi was part chihuahua. You could get her to howl whenever you played "Chopsticks" on the piano. She would crawl under my covers to sleep by my feet—I don't know how she breathed!
